Liberation War fundraiser repaid with name listed among embezzlers
2021-08-13T21:20:04+06:00 | Star News+
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news/liberation-war-fundraiser-repaid-name-listed-among-embezzlers-2151641

The story of Gouranga Saha Roy is one of cruel irony -- of being among the diaspora Bangalees who raised funds for the Liberation War of 1971 only to find his name listed with embezzlers after.

Now in his old age -- during the golden jubilee of the country's independence -- trying to recoup his dignity, he is tired of dealing with administrative complications of the same country, the birth of which he is inextricably linked to.

The Daily Star published a report on this incident. In Star News+ watch the story of Gouranga Saha Roy as he stages his belated fight for recognition.
